name: Wrong Turn Tee
description: For the route you didn’t mean to take. A pine-green tee with a small Backroad Bum chest print.
summary: An easy everyday layer, from the first coffee stop to the drive home. This first edition is shown in size M, with a relaxed fit.
specs: Demo design: cotton jersey, pine green, relaxed unisex M. Wash cool with similar colors; dry away from direct heat.

name: Creekside Camp Mug
description: A blue enamel-style mug for slow coffee and a second look at the map.
summary: A simple camp-table companion with a generous handle. The bright blue rim makes it easy to spot among the breakfast things.
specs: Demo design: enamel-coated steel, 12 fl oz, blue rim. Hand wash and dry after use. Not for the microwave; hot drinks can heat the handle.

name: Last Light Fleece
description: The layer you reach for when the sun slips behind the trees.
summary: A pullover for the hour between packing dinner away and deciding to stay outside a little longer. Shown in size M.
specs: Demo design: brushed cotton-blend fleece, clay brown, relaxed unisex M. A comfort layer, not technical weather protection. Wash cool; air dry.

name: Long Way Cap
description: A low-profile cap in dusty ochre. For open windows and unhurried miles.
summary: Soft canvas, an adjustable back and a small stitched wordmark. Nothing to prove, nowhere to hurry.
specs: Demo design: cotton canvas, adjustable adult fit, ochre. Spot clean and air dry. Not rated as protective sun equipment.

name: Glovebox Field Tote
description: Room for the map, the market stop and the things that never fit back in their boxes.
summary: A plain, roomy tote that folds down between trips. Keep one near the door and let the weekend decide what goes in it.
specs: Demo design: unbleached canvas, two carry handles, open top, 16 × 15 inches. Not waterproof. Spot clean; allow to dry fully before storing.
